snippet.title: Thandel - Official Trailer | Naga Chaitanya, Sai Pallavi | Chandoo Mondeti | Devi Sri Prasad
snippet.description:
Watch Thandel - Official Trailer | Naga Chaitanya, Sai Pallavi | Chandoo Mondeti | Devi Sri Prasad

#ThandelonFeb7th

Setting sail to the adventurous voyage ⛵ - #Dhullakotteyala 🔥

Worldwide Grand Release on FEB 7th, 2025.

Thandel is our upcoming feature film Presented by Allu Aravind, Starring Naga Chaitanya, Sai Pallavi in Lead roles. Directed by Chandoo Mondeti. Music by Devi Sri Prasad. Editing by Navin Nooli. Cinematography by Shamdat. Produced by Bunny Vas under Geetha Arts Banner.
